description: Live liquidation clusters (long and short walls with prices, notional, distance from spot), stop-loss and take-profit pools, and positioning stats for a Hyperliquid perp, computed from ~100k tracked wallets and refreshed every ~15 s. Default view: walls within 5% of spot, biggest per side; range/levels widen it to the full ladder.

levels.description: max walls per side, biggest first, e.g. '50', or 'all'

range.description: % band around spot to include, e.g. '25', or 'all'

symbol.description: Perp ticker: BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE

name: get_liquidation_heatmap
title: Hyperliquid liquidation heatmap
